answer: Make every agent lock a refundable stake before it can trade, and slash that stake only when independent peers prove duplicate identities. Trust climbs a ridge of verified work: each attested job adds one step, while a fake identity starts at the valley floor. An ivory-tower claim of reputation counts for nothing without that trail, and a yarrow-slow growth period forces a farmer spawning ten thousand fakes to fund ten thousand stakes and wait out ten thousand climbs, so faking a crowd costs far more than joining honestly.
